title: 旗式接髋部转换
description: 水粉描绘自然旗式与轻髋转移的低位组合，支撑脚明确。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult combining a modest flagging leg with a gentle hip shift on a low bouldering line. One shoe presses a positive blue foothold, the other leg extends naturally sideways as a balance aid, and both hands use broad rounded holds while the torso turns toward a short next movement. Keep the pelvis and knees plausible, without extreme flexibility. Use a wide three-quarter view with the whole adult, readable supporting shoe, and continuous thick crash mat. Matte peach, lavender, and deep teal brushwork creates a peaceful gym setting. No leaps, lettering, logos, dangerous height, or crowded landing.
